name: ast-tools
description: Isolated sub-package holding the ONE real dependency (typescript) this project needs, for the ONE check (C2 premium-fetch AST re-derivation) that genuinely cannot be done honestly with a regex. Kept out of the root package.json so the core engine and npm test stay zero-dependency by default — this install is opt-in, only needed to run engine/scanners/authz-access.mjs's AST check.
